mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is "HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions": all hosts, internal hosts included, are reached over HTTPS, and plain HTTP is not permitted for internal hosts.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. It says the current decision is "HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions", so internal hosts use HTTPS too and plain HTTP isn't allowed for them.

Two records conflict on this. Record #22 said internal hosts would use plain HTTP. Record #23, made a few seconds later, said "https everywhere, no exceptions" and explicitly overrides #22, so I treated #23 as current. The file doesn't mention the retired plain-HTTP position.

Both records are only episodes (trust 1), not formal decisions, so there is no formally recorded decision to cite. If #22 was actually the intended policy, tell me and I'll change the file.
